about: LedgerLens decision eval set. Each case is a bank statement (or a bad input) and the credit outcome a careful analyst would expect. Expected values come from the statement's design (what was planted in it) and are the same values documented in the README test tables. All statements are synthetic; no real customer data.

criteria.decision: Final recommendation matches (APPROVE / APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS / REFER / DECLINE). This is the one that matters most: a wrong decision is a wrong credit call.
criteria.reason: When the decision is driven by a hard rule (FOIR, no income, tampering, jumbled pages), the stated reason names that rule, so an analyst can see why.
criteria.score: Composite score (0-1000) is exactly the documented value. Catches silent scoring drift.
criteria.transactions: Number of transactions extracted is exactly the documented value. A missed or duplicated row changes every downstream number.
criteria.review: Rows the engine is unsure about are sent to the human review queue instead of being guessed.
criteria.safe_stop: Inputs that cannot be analysed safely stop with a clear message and a non-zero exit code instead of producing a score.
